queries:
SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS order_count,
       COUNT(*) - (SELECT AVG(c) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id)) AS diff
FROM "order" o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH oc AS (
    SELECT o.account_id, a.district_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM "order" o
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
    GROUP BY o.account_id, a.district_id
),
avgc AS (
    SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM oc
),
diffs AS (
    SELECT oc.account_id, d.A3 AS region, oc.cnt AS order_count, oc.cnt - avgc.avg_cnt AS diff
    FROM oc
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = oc.district_id
    CROSS JOIN avgc
)
SELECT account_id, region, order_count, diff
FROM diffs
WHERE diff >= (SELECT diff FROM diffs ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9)
ORDER BY diff DESC;
WITH oc AS (
  SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM "order" o
  JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3
),
diffs AS (
  SELECT account_id, region, order_count,
         order_count - AVG(order_count) OVER () AS diff
  FROM oc
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT account_id, region, order_count, diff,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY diff DESC) AS rnk
  FROM diffs
)
SELECT account_id, region, order_count, diff
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk <= 10
ORDER BY diff DESC;
WITH oc AS (
    SELECT o.account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM "order" o
    GROUP BY o.account_id
),
avg_oc AS (
    SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM oc
)
SELECT oc.account_id,
       d.A3 AS region,
       oc.order_count,
       oc.order_count - avg_oc.avg_count AS difference
FROM oc
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = oc.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
CROSS JOIN avg_oc
WHERE oc.order_count > avg_oc.avg_count
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
